title: A rename, then the rename taken back
measures: a correction undoes the agent's own work cleanly and keeps what was asked to stay

turns.say: Rename the module `shop/utils.py` to `shop/textutils.py`, everywhere it is named. And add `shout(text)` to it: upper case with one `!` at the end, no second `!` when the text already ends with one. The tests must still pass.
I take the rename back: the module is `shop/utils.py` again, everywhere, exactly as it was before. Keep `shout`.
